تستغرقون (form X)
# تَسْتَغْرِقُونَ (tastaḡriqūna) /tas.taɣ.ri.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
# تُسْتَغْرَقُونَ (tustaḡraqūna) /tus.taɣ.ra.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَغْرَقَ (istaḡraqa)
